learning: Counter to strict regeneration: in a hotfix, hand-editing generated gateway types to match the production response is acceptable when regenerating would pull unreleased staging contract changes into the fix. State in the PR that the codegen check is expected to fail, and regenerate on the next normal sync.

title: Redundant try/catch around a callee that already swallows and logs
learning: Read the callee's error contract before wrapping it. If a helper already catches, logs and resolves void, an outer try/catch is dead code that misleads readers about what can fail. Call it directly and note in a comment that it never throws.

title: Constant values re-typed as literals or duplicated across flows
learning: When a named constant already defines a value or shape (a capability payload, a timeout, a user-facing timeout message), import it instead of retyping the literal. When two flows in one app need the same constant, extract it to a single module so a change lands in one place.

title: Validator accepted a namespace key shape the chain reader did not parse
learning: When a spec allows several input shapes (WalletConnect `eip155` with a `chains` array, or CAIP-2 keyed `eip155:1` with no `chains`), the validator and every extractor must handle the same set. Otherwise inputs that pass validation fail later with a misleading error. Add a test for each accepted shape.

title: Fixed-snap bottom sheet clipped content under large dynamic type
learning: A sheet or container with fixed-percentage height and a pinned footer must make its variable content scrollable (for example with BottomSheetScrollView and footer clearance padding). Otherwise large system fonts or longer copy get clipped under the CTA.

title: Hardcoded rgba hover colour instead of a theme token
learning: Arbitrary colour values in class names, such as `dark:hover:bg-[rgba(...)]`, should become a named theme token defined for both light and dark themes and consumed through the token utility class.

title: Submit paths left the in-flight flag stuck or closed the dialog over its own error
learning: Every exit from an async submit must leave the UI recoverable: set the submitting flag only after early-return branches (or clear it in `finally`), and when a dialog renders its own error, close it only on success so the user can read the error and retry. Clear the previous error at the start of each attempt.

title: One of two create paths skipped the post-create persistence side effect
learning: When several flows create the same entity (an onboarding flow and a modal), they must run the same post-create side effects: persisting the last-used id, tracking and routing. Prefer one shared post-create helper so a new path cannot skip a step.

title: Legacy-ID URL fallback deliberately dropped during an identifier cutover
learning: Counter to always dual-accepting legacy identifiers: during an ID migration the frontend may cut over deliberately, letting legacy URLs fall through to re-selection instead of keeping a compatibility branch. The cutover must be stated in the PR description and test plan.

title: Clipboard paste handler validated empty input and let read errors escape
learning: Handlers that read device APIs such as the clipboard must catch read failures and exit early on empty or whitespace results. They must not feed the value into validation that shows a false error or leave an unhandled rejection.

title: Triple-nested ternary chose a JSX overlay by status
learning: Replace nested ternaries in JSX that pick content by a status enum with a small component or function that switches on the status and returns null by default. It reads flat and future-proofs against noImplicitReturns.

title: Degraded fallback result dropped a mode flag the success branch sets
learning: When a hook adds a fallback branch (primary source errored, return secondary data), the fallback result must carry the same mode/metadata flags as the success branch. Otherwise UI keyed on those flags, such as tooltips or labels, silently changes in the degraded state.

title: Non-fatal secondary source still gates loading to avoid a partial-then-full flash
learning: Counter to 'render as soon as the primary source is ready': a secondary source whose error is non-fatal may still hold the loading state while it is in flight. This avoids a flash of partial content (tokens, then tokens plus positions). Choose this deliberately for the UX, not by accident.

title: Address and duplicate validation normalized inputs differently per path
learning: Validation of the same user-entered field must normalize identically on every path and on both sides of a comparison: viem's `isAddress` is strict-checksum by default, so a lowercase paste failed one form while passing a sibling that used ethers; a duplicate check trimmed the new value but not existing rows, letting padded duplicates through. Normalize (trim, case, `getAddress`) once, then validate and compare.

title: Malformed date string silently treated as not expired
learning: new Date(bad).getTime() is NaN and every comparison with NaN is false, so an expiry/deadline check on a malformed backend date silently returns the 'not expired' answer. Guard parsed timestamps with Number.isFinite before comparing.

title: Effect deps on an unstable callback or a whole collection re-fired side effects
learning: A child effect that lists a parent's inline callback re-runs (and re-validates) on every parent render unless the parent passes a `useCallback`; an effect keyed on a whole collection re-emits external events for every existing item whenever one changes. Key effects on the value that should trigger them and keep dep references stable.

title: New workflow shipped without an explicit permissions block
learning: Every GitHub Actions workflow should declare a least-privilege `permissions:` block (at minimum `contents: read`) instead of inheriting the default token scope; this is the other half of the empty-permissions case in CI-04.

title: One-off inline sx override kept next to an existing CSS module
learning: When a component already uses a CSS module, move remaining inline `sx` style overrides (pseudo-element resets, borders) into that module instead of mixing both, so styling lives in one place.

title: Relaxing a shared pending-status hook without auditing its other gates
learning: Before changing what a shared status predicate returns (e.g. treating an intermediate state as not pending), list every consumer and the reason each one gates on it; the same hook can protect unrelated flows such as nonce recommendation for new transactions, not only the button being fixed.

title: Bespoke overflow menu instead of the shared menu component
learning: Before building a UI widget for a common pattern (overflow '...' menus, context menus, confirm sheets), search for the component the app already uses for it and reuse it. Reusing keeps interaction behaviour (dismissal, placement, destructive styling) consistent and avoids re-solving edge cases the shared component already handles.

title: Unnecessary type cast on a typed route
learning: Do not add `as X` casts to satisfy the compiler when the value is already correctly typed or the proper fix is upstream (e.g. regenerating typed routes). Casts hide real type errors from future refactors; remove them or fix the source type.

title: Multi-line docstrings on self-explanatory code
learning: Keep code comments to a short WHY where it is not obvious from names and types; trim multi-line JSDoc that restates WHAT the code does. The repo's AGENTS.md treats comments as tech debt, and reviewers ask to shorten verbose ones.

title: Test redeclared user-facing copy instead of importing the exported constant
learning: When production code exports a constant for user-facing copy, tests should assert against that constant rather than redeclaring the strings. Duplicated literals drift silently and leave the export looking unused.

title: New npm package added for a small runtime patch
learning: Be conservative about adding third-party npm dependencies. For a small patch, prefer upgrading an existing dependency that already contains the fix or vendoring the (permissively licensed) code, instead of taking on a new package and its supply-chain risk.

title: Visible-flow change merged only after product input; copy decided in ticket
learning: Changes that add or reword user-visible flows need product/design sign-off; reviewers may block on it. Once product has decided copy in the ticket, reviewer copy suggestions defer to that decision.

title: Removal/rename consumers missed: E2E copy assertions and dynamic imports
learning: Consumers a type-check cannot see still count: user-visible copy asserted by Cypress constants or Maestro `assertVisible`, and template-literal `import()` paths in lazy feature loaders. Search for them before changing strings or deleting code as dead.

title: Re-implemented shared UI and derivations instead of reusing/extracting them
learning: Before adding a component or computation, reuse an existing wrapper that already owns the behaviour (e.g. a copy-tooltip wrapper). When the same store reads, guard derivation, row markup or sheet scaffolding appear in two or three call sites, extract one hook/component so copy, styling and logic cannot drift, and keep one derivation as the source of truth instead of mirroring it into state from an effect.

title: Nested interactive element (button inside button)
learning: Do not render an interactive element (button, link, role=button) inside another interactive element; it is invalid HTML/ARIA and causes hydration errors. Render the inner control as a non-button element with its own keyboard handling, or move the outer affordance.

title: Intentionally inert control not announced as disabled
learning: When a control must stay focusable/enabled so nested actions keep working but its own activation does nothing, set `aria-disabled` so assistive tech announces it as disabled; native `disabled` would also disable the nested actions.

title: Hardcoded colours and raw spacing values instead of theme tokens
learning: Use theme tokens for colours and spacing, including one-off icon/spinner colours and mobile Tamagui paddings. A spinner inside a themed button should inherit the button's foreground (`color="inherit"`/currentColor) so a token swap cannot make it invisible.

title: Inline sx style on a class-styled module
learning: In a component styled through a CSS module, move one-off inline `sx` values into a named const or module class so the styling pattern stays consistent.

title: Test mock kept a stale prop contract; no test for the fixed invariant
learning: When a component's contract changes, update its mocks to match (a mock that still accepts `children` lies about the API). A fix for a bug class should add a test for the invariant itself, not just the on/off rendering it already had.

title: Negated assertion against a class that never existed
learning: A `not.toMatch(...)` guard against a value that was never present passes vacuously. Express the protected behaviour positively (the nested control renders and is not inside a disabled element).

title: Keyboard handler supported Enter and Space but only Enter was tested
learning: When a handler branches on several inputs (Enter and Space, several key codes), cover each handled input; a table-driven `it.each` keeps it cheap.

title: Zero-address MultiSend target rewritten regardless of contract version
learning: Contract behaviour that differs by version (e.g. MultiSend defaulting a zero `to` to `address(this)` only from v1.5.0) must be gated on the actual deployment/version from safe-deployments, not applied to every batch.

title: Hex quantities parsed with Number / compared as strings
learning: Parse hex/bigint quantities (chain ids, block numbers, gas) with `BigInt`, since `Number` loses precision above 2^53. Guard the parse: `parseInt` yields NaN and `BigInt` throws on malformed input, so reject with an invalid-params error. Compare quantities numerically, not as hex strings (`0x01` vs `0x1`).

title: Errors misclassified: silent fallbacks and generic codes treated as rate limits
learning: Error handling must classify on specific evidence and stay visible: a catch that degrades to a fallback result still logs a breadcrumb (symmetrically across sibling branches), and retry/rate-limit handling keys on HTTP 429 or JSON-RPC -32005, never a catch-all like -32603 that also covers real execution failures. Add negative tests for the exclusion.

title: Protocol side effects inside screens, invisible components and god providers
learning: Screens and hooks should only dispatch user intent; SDK/protocol responses and request-lifecycle state machines belong in Redux listener middleware that reads live state from the store at processing time. Split a growing provider into focused hooks, and let a provider resolve its own value from an id instead of coupling the container to it.

title: New direct dependency pinned to the already-resolved transitive version
learning: When promoting a transitive dependency to a direct one, pin it to the version already resolved in the lockfile unless an upgrade is intended and verified, so other packages are not moved and the bundle doesn't carry two copies.

title: Effect early-return skipped registering its cleanup
learning: An effect that early-returns (error shown, permission missing) must still return the cleanup that undoes resources other paths may have acquired, such as pausing a camera on blur; otherwise the invariant silently relies on code elsewhere.

title: Module-level registration cleared by a stale effect cleanup
learning: When an effect assigns a module-level singleton (bridge, handler), its cleanup must clear it only if it still owns it (identity check); otherwise a double mount (HMR, strict mode, tests) lets the first cleanup wipe the live registration.

title: Discriminated-union else branch silently absorbs future kinds
learning: When branching on a discriminant, handle each kind explicitly and end with a `never` exhaustiveness check so a newly added kind fails at compile time instead of falling into another kind's path.

title: Context value object literal rebuilt every render
learning: Object/array literals passed as a context value (or as memo deps) must be memoized, or every consumer re-renders on each parent render.

title: Speculative micro-optimizations declined when the working set is tiny
learning: Decline performance changes that lack profiling evidence when the input is provably small (a handful of chains, a per-request Set rebuild); document the bound instead of adding memoization or eviction.

title: Input sanitized only on blur; dirty check compared raw value
learning: When a form field normalizes or sanitizes its value on blur, treat that as display-only. Apply the same sanitizer at the submit boundary, and compare the sanitized value in dirty/hasChanges checks. Enter-to-submit skips blur, and a raw comparison enables Save for edits that sanitize back to the stored value.

title: Type errors silenced with @ts-ignore or divergent field types instead of typed paths
learning: Don't suppress a type error with `@ts-ignore` when a typed helper exists for the operation (e.g. extracting an RTK Query error message), and give a new DTO field the type the rest of the app uses for that value (nonce as number) so call sites don't need `String()`/`Number()` casts.

title: Value read in async callback missing from dependency array under eslint-disable
learning: When `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` is suppressed on a useAsync/useEffect/useMemo, every value the callback reads that should retrigger it must still be listed by hand. The suppression also hides genuine omissions like a deployed flag.

title: Verbose comments; declined suggestion to add an explanatory comment
learning: Keep comments short and only where the WHY is non-obvious; reviewers ask to shrink verbose multi-line explanations, and authors can decline bot suggestions to add comments that restate behaviour.

title: Mobile E2E matchers loose enough to pass on the wrong screen state
learning: E2E text matchers must not be satisfiable by unrelated UI. Anchor regexes on the distinguishing punctuation (`View,` not `View.*`), key common labels like 'Continue' to a testID, and never widen a status alternation to terminal states the test is meant to rule out. A new testID that an E2E flow depends on needs a component test so a refactor can't silently drop it.

title: Bug-fix test covered only the happy branch and typed fixtures off generated API
learning: A regression test for a render gate should cover each negative branch of the condition (loading, empty), not just the success case. Derive fixture types from the consumer's own type (e.g. `NonNullable<FormValues['field']>['data'][number]`) instead of importing generated API types directly, so shape changes surface at the consumer.

title: Stored back-navigation origin never scoped or cleared
learning: A persisted navigation origin (the target of a Back link) must carry the context it was captured in (e.g. the spaceId) and be honoured only when that context still matches; otherwise fall back to the default landing. A sticky, only-ever-set origin misroutes later visits entered by other paths. How long an origin stays valid within the same context is a product tradeoff and can be accepted explicitly.

title: Removed UI control still used by Cypress flows
learning: When a PR removes a visible control (button, link, nav entry), search the E2E suites for flows that click through it and update them in the same change, as you would for a removed export.

title: Per-component dark-mode hook instead of global theme
learning: Dark mode should come from the root theme provider and cascade through CSS variables/tokens. Don't branch styling on a per-component `useDarkMode()` hook or wrap components in local dark wrappers.

title: Shared table left cell layout and free-form className to every caller
learning: A shared table/list component should own structural styling for header and body cells, e.g. per-column cell renderers plus a small bounded variant API (align, emphasis, width), rather than callers hand-rendering body cells with free-form className. Standard components should be styled through their variants and sizes, not one-off class overrides.

title: Dead jest.mock left after removing the mocked dependency
learning: When a component stops using a module, remove the test's `jest.mock` for it too. Dead mocks mislead readers about what the component depends on.

title: Pure helper declared inside a hook's effect
learning: A helper that reads no hook state, props, or closure values belongs at module scope, not inside the hook body or a useEffect. Declaring it inline re-creates it every run and hides that it is a pure function that can be tested on its own.

title: One-shot notification deduped by entity id only
learning: When a hook dedupes one-shot notifications, the dedup key must include whatever changes on a real repeat (for example a resend's new expiry), not just the entity id, or the second occurrence is dropped without a trace. When the underlying state resolves somewhere else, dismiss the toast that is already showing, not only the dedup entry.

title: Same tooltip/list pattern copy-pasted across components
learning: When the same presentational pattern, such as a chain-list-plus-tooltip, a disabled-button tooltip wrapper, or a repeated tooltip string, appears in several components, extract one shared component or constant. If the current PR has a different scope, do the extraction in a separate follow-up PR rather than growing the fix.

title: Owner/signer address match used case-sensitive key lookup
learning: Matching addresses from two sources, such as imported signers and CGW owners, must not rely on object-key or string equality, because the two sides can differ in checksum casing. Normalize both sides or use sameAddress, and add a test with mixed-case inputs.

title: Second query with different args re-fetches data already cached
learning: Consumers that need data another query already loaded must call it with the same args, or read the cached result first and widen only when something is missing. A different arg (trusted=false, all vs deployed-only list) is a separate cache entry and a second network request, not a dedup.

title: Amount helper silently defaulted missing decimals / no-op rebuild
learning: Shared helpers that encode on-chain amounts must throw when a value that sets the unit (such as decimals) is missing, instead of defaulting to 0 or 18. A rebuild that silently returns the input unchanged, for example because an index is stale, should also throw rather than look like a successful no-op save.

title: Raw pixel and numeric-string spacing next to theme tokens
learning: Mobile spacing and font sizes should use the theme's tokens ($2, $3, and so on), not raw numbers or numeric strings like "2". Raw values drift when the token scale changes, and numeric strings may be coerced or ignored without any type error.

title: Error log printed a deep-link path containing a session secret
learning: Never log raw URIs, deep links, or request payloads that can carry secrets, such as WalletConnect symKeys, tokens, or signatures. In catch blocks, log only a redacted form like the scheme or first path segment.

title: Global bigint replacer rewrote nested typed-data fields
learning: When serializing EIP-712 typed data for a wallet, convert only the specific field that needs it (domain.chainId to a number, with a safe-integer guard). Do not use a global replacer that matches a key name at any depth. Lock the change with a test asserting TypedDataEncoder.hash is unchanged.

title: Validated the sanitized name but submitted the raw one
learning: If validation runs on a normalized or sanitized value, every submit path must send that same normalized value. Otherwise the UI enables submit for input the backend rejects, and different flows diverge.

title: Hand-rolled deepClone instead of the existing lodash helper
learning: Before writing a generic utility (deep clone, debounce, deep-equal), use the one already in the repo's dependencies or shared utils. Hand-rolled versions quietly drop Map, Set, Date, and prototypes and need their own tests.

title: Feature code imported from test setup; fixtures built with `as` casts
learning: Feature and production code must not import from test setup or e2e harness folders. Keep shared fixtures next to the fake that uses them. Build fixtures as typed literals instead of `as SomeType` casts, so upstream type changes fail at compile time rather than in a runtime e2e run.

title: Dependency bump bypassed the npm age gate via preapproved packages
learning: Do not add third-party packages to `npmPreapprovedPackages` (or any other age-gate bypass) to land a freshly published version. The cooldown is a supply-chain control, so wait it out and merge the bump afterwards. The preapproved list is only for in-house `@safe-global/*` packages.

title: Parent kept a ref to a child's imperative handle after the child unmounted
learning: A parent that tracks a child's imperative handle, such as the currently open swipeable row, must clear that ref when the child unmounts. Capture the handle at mount time, because the ref detaches before cleanup runs. Otherwise later logic acts on a stale handle.

title: Signatures wider or looser than what the function needs
learning: Type a hook or function by what it actually needs: an input it cannot work without is required, not an optional callback gated with `Boolean(cb)` (a caller who omits it silently turns the feature off), and a parameter is typed by the fields it reads (a narrow object or `Pick<T, …>`) so callers need no casts or fake objects and ignored inputs stay visible.

title: Effect early-return left a loading flag stuck true
learning: Every branch of an async effect, including the early return for empty input, must reset loading or resolving flags and derived state. If a resolve was in flight when the input went empty, its cancelled continuation never clears the flag, and anything gated on isLoading hangs.

title: Diff-based save produced phantom removals
learning: Save flows that diff the current selection against the existing set must not produce removals the user did not ask for. Seed form defaults only after the query-backed existing set has loaded, and make bulk or group toggles skip locked or disabled items. Otherwise Save deletes members through a control the UI shows as disabled, or before the data arrived.

title: Workspace membership keyed by address only; child rows used parent aggregate
learning: Lookups built from per-chain API data must be keyed by chainId:address, deduping by address only when deliberately rendering a multi-chain aggregate. Expanded per-network rows must read their own chain's values (threshold, owners), not the parent aggregate resolved for the current chain.

title: Shared button hardcoded one surface's analytics label
learning: A shared UI primitive rendered on several surfaces must not hardcode one surface's analytics label. Expose an optional callback such as onCopy or onOpen, or a label prop, so each call site tags its own event.

title: Re-implemented a helper, hook, or component that already exists
learning: Before adding a copy tooltip, severity comparator, address normalizer, or selection or submit flow, search for the existing shared primitive and reuse it. When a new block is copy-pasted between two flows, extract a hook and test it once. Duplicates drift: here the picker already differed from onboarding in whether added safes are trusted.

title: Ad-hoc toLowerCase() address comparisons instead of sameAddress
learning: Address equality and dedupe checks should go through sameAddress (or normalizeAddress for keys), not hand-written `a.toLowerCase() === b.toLowerCase()` or `Object.keys(x).some(k => k.toLowerCase() === …)`.

title: Counter: do not normalize an address that is rendered for visual comparison
learning: Normalize addresses for comparison and keys, but render the user-supplied casing wherever users compare characters by eye (poisoning or look-alike highlights). Normalizing for display removes the checksum casing that helps users tell look-alikes apart.

title: Counter: memoizing react-hook-form watch() arrays freezes the value
learning: Do not wrap react-hook-form `watch()` results in useMemo or useMemoDeepCompare. RHF mutates the returned array in place, so the reference never changes and memoized consumers stop re-running. Derive a primitive key (for example the joined values) and depend on that instead.

title: Counter: useMemo on a trivial string slice
learning: Do not wrap cheap, bounded computations, such as slicing a 40-character address, in useMemo. The memo bookkeeping costs more than the work. Keep useMemo for derivations that are expensive or whose reference identity feeds other hooks.

title: Context registration hook never cleared on unmount
learning: A hook that registers values into a shared context, such as addresses to analyse, must clear its registration in the effect cleanup. Otherwise stale values linger after the flow unmounts and drive results that no current screen asked for.

title: Full address-book scan per matched item
learning: When each item in a list needs a lookup into another collection, build the normalized lookup map once, memoized on the source collection, instead of scanning and re-normalizing the whole collection per item. That turns O(N·M) into O(N+M).

title: Verbose multi-line code comments
learning: Keep code comments short. State the non-obvious why in a line or two instead of multi-paragraph narration of what the code does. Long comments rot as the design changes: here they still described a two-tier severity model that had been dropped.

title: Local copy of a backend validation schema went stale
learning: Do not hand-mirror backend validation (name regexes, length caps, messages) in app code. Consume the shared validator in `packages/utils`, which is kept in line with CGW. A local mirror falls behind the backend, as here where it missed the new UTF-8 rules.

title: Hard-coded hex mock addresses in unit tests
learning: Generate mock addresses in unit tests with faker (`faker.finance.ethereumAddress()`) or builders instead of hand-built constants such as `toBeHex('0x1', 20)`. Randomized data exposes hidden assumptions about casing and ordering.

title: Lookup keys and query args not shared consistently
learning: Shared lookups must key the same way for every caller: a map from a shared utility is keyed by the normalized address (original casing kept on the value), and a second hook that fires the same query only for its loading or error state passes the primary consumer's exact args, since all-safes vs deployed-only is a different cache key and a second request.

title: Click-handler async work left unhandled or untracked
learning: A lazy RTK trigger called from a click handler must `.unwrap()` in try/catch and reset in-flight state in `finally`, or a network failure becomes an unhandled rejection; a timer started from a handler keeps its id so a repeat press replaces it and unmount clears it.

title: `?? 0` fallback made a loading or invalid value look valid
learning: Do not replace a not-yet-loaded or impossible value with `?? 0` when 0 is a valid-looking input, such as a nonce lower bound or a nonce. Gate the interaction until the value is known, and render the dependent modal only when it is defined. For supposedly unreachable branches, throw or drop the fallback instead of inventing a value.

title: Test kept mocking a module the component no longer imports
learning: When a change removes a dependency from a component, remove that module's mocks and spies from its tests too. Dead mocks suggest a dependency that no longer exists and hide that the test no longer exercises it.

title: Migration target taken from the global latest version, not the chain's recommendation
learning: Chain-dependent contract decisions, such as migration targets or offering in-app migration versus the CLI, must use the active chain's recommended or capped Safe version. Do not fall back to a global LATEST_SAFE_VERSION default. Otherwise web and mobile disagree about eligibility on chains whose recommendation differs.

title: Deployment lookup fell back to another flavour's address or the default type
learning: When resolving a contract for a specific deployment type (canonical, eip155, zksync), request that exact type. If the type has no deployment, throw or report unavailable. Do not fall back to the first network address or to the default canonical type, or the UI offers a migration that points at an incompatible contract.

title: One derivation computed twice or rebuilt beside an existing hook
learning: When one derived set drives several UI decisions (row badge, confirmation gate, select-all), compute it once from one input scope and pass it down; two hooks over different inputs made the badge and the gate disagree. Likewise, check whether an existing hook (e.g. `useAllSafes`) already provides the items before rebuilding them from raw slices, and extend its return instead of adding a thin wrapper hook.

title: Counter: no call-site dedupe when the consuming hook already dedupes
learning: Normalize and dedupe once, at the boundary that owns the operation. Callers passing into a hook that already dedupes its input (for example through dedupeUsableAddresses) should not add their own pass.

title: Stale duplicate test suite left in the app after tests moved to the package
learning: When a helper and its canonical tests move into a shared package, delete or update the old app-level test suite for it in the same change. The stale copy asserts the old behaviour and fails CI, or worse, keeps passing against defaults that no longer mean what it assumes.

title: Double cast to satisfy a parameter wider than what the helper reads
learning: If a caller has to write `{…} as Pick<T, 'a' | 'b'> as T` because the helper only reads a few fields, narrow the helper's parameter to `Pick<T, 'a' | 'b'>`. The signature then documents the real dependency and the cast disappears.

title: Mapping and merge logic left where no unit test reaches it
learning: Conversion of an external payload into local types (enum mapping, unknown-value fallback) belongs in a pure helper with a test per mapped value, not inline in an event handler; and a wrapper hook that merges two results needs its own test for merge order, preserved fields, and OR-ed loading/error when consumer tests mock it as a passthrough.

title: Test fixtures hand-copy a decoder's output contract
learning: Fixtures for decoded or normalized data should be produced by running raw-input builders through the real decoder, with test overrides spread on top. Hand-written normalized literals and frozen outputs of deleted generator scripts drift from the real contract silently; keep only captured real-world fixtures on disk.

title: Comments too long, duplicated, or missing where a choice is deliberate
learning: Comments stay short and factual: never longer than the code they explain, not repeated between source and test, no 'same reason as above' cross-references. Where the code makes a deliberate non-obvious choice (declined hardening, a load-bearing default-before-spread order), one line stating the reason keeps a later edit from 'fixing' it the wrong way.

title: Invariant claimed in docs but not pinned by a test
learning: When code or its docs claim a property such as order independence or idempotence, add a test that would break it (for example the same input reversed must derive the same result). Otherwise a refactor can lose the property with every test still green.

title: Utility type redefined instead of reused from an existing dependency
learning: Before declaring a common type alias, reuse the equivalent from a package the workspace already depends on. Do not add a new dependency to a shared package (which mobile also consumes) just to import one type.

title: Hardcoded hex fallback inside a theme CSS variable
learning: Do not add a literal fallback to a theme token (`var(--token, #hex)`). The fallback is the light-mode value, so it is wrong in dark mode and hides a missing token. Reference the token alone.

title: Overlay-link row re-enables pointer events on plain text
learning: In a row made clickable by an absolutely positioned anchor, re-enable pointer events only on real controls (buttons, links, copy/explorer actions). Plain text such as the name must click through to the anchor. Otherwise the click bubbles to a JS row handler that calls router.push, and Ctrl/Cmd-click no longer opens a new tab.

title: Negative verdicts and removals decided before the definitive cause was known
learning: A CRITICAL security finding or destructive diff must rest on a definitive result: a guard check that fails on an RPC outage or rate limit reports an analysis error rather than a verdict, and a one-shot form reset that seeds from query data waits until the query has resolved, or a later save treats existing items as removed.

title: Replacement helper or hook added beside the old one instead of replacing it
learning: When a hook misbehaves in one context, fix or extend the existing hook rather than adding a sibling variant callers must choose between; when introducing a replacement helper, migrate every call site in the touched scope or state why the old one remains.

title: E2E flows rely on backend list order and loose text matches
learning: E2E flows (Cypress or Maestro) must not rely on the order of backend-provided lists or on text any row could match. Target rows by a stable per-entity test ID (e.g. including the tx id), and reach list items by searching or filtering rather than by assumed scroll order.

title: `any` cast in a shared-hook test fixture
learning: Type test fixtures as the real return type (or use `satisfies`) instead of `as any`, so the fixture breaks when the shared hook's shape changes.

title: Empty-state walkthrough rendered beside an 'unsupported' notice
learning: When a feature is unavailable in the current context, suppress the empty-state onboarding or walkthrough as well as the create action. Otherwise the page says creation is impossible and then explains how to create.

title: Telemetry noise filter matches a whole URL prefix
learning: Filters that drop 'expected' failures from telemetry must match the exact route and status that is known noise, not a URL prefix. Sibling endpoints under the same prefix have genuine failures that would disappear from monitoring.

title: Deployment type assumed or protocol constants unanchored to real deployments
learning: Classify a Safe implementation by resolving its deployment type (canonical, eip155, zksync) from safe-deployments, not 'canonical or not' (zkSync eip155 singletons are EVM-compatible), and anchor every pinned protocol constant that decides addresses (bytecode hash, singleton address) to a test against a real on-chain deployment.

title: Hand-rolled fetch effect instead of an RTK Query endpoint
learning: Fetch gateway data through the generated RTK Query hooks from the shared store package, not ad-hoc fetch calls in `useEffect` with manual cancelled flags and error state. That keeps caching and error handling consistent and makes the logic reusable on mobile.

title: Navigation CTA rendered through the Button primitive loses link semantics
learning: A CTA that navigates should stay a link: style the anchor with the button variants helper instead of rendering it through the Button primitive with `nativeButton={false}`. The Button primitive gives the anchor `role="button"`, which removes it from link navigation and breaks Space activation for keyboard and screen-reader users.

title: Nested next/dynamic boundary inside an already lazy-loaded feature
learning: Do not wrap a component in `next/dynamic` inside a feature that is already reached through feature-level lazy loading. The extra chunk renders an empty loading state on first client render, so the component (and any children passed to it) flashes out; export it directly through the feature's public API.

title: Test mocks the deep hook path while the component imports the barrel
learning: Mock the module path the code under test actually imports. If the component imports a hook from a feature barrel, the barrel's `jest.mock` must provide it; a separate mock of the deep file is dead, and the barrel mock returns undefined for the missing export.

title: Env var restore assigns undefined back to process.env
learning: Restoring an environment variable that was originally unset must `delete` it. Assigning `undefined` to `process.env` stores the string 'undefined'. Put the save/restore in one shared test helper and use it everywhere instead of ad-hoc copies.

title: Blanket useAppSelector mock returns one value for every selector
learning: Do not mock the store hook as `useAppSelector: () => constant`. Every selector in the rendered tree then receives the same value, which can hide regressions in unrelated consumers. Use a real test store with a preloaded slice, or a selector-aware mock.

title: Separate single-item and array variants of the same hook
learning: Keep one hook per concept. Instead of a single-item variant beside an array variant, have one hook take an array (callers wrap a single value), so logic and fixes live in one place.

title: Derived filtered list recomputed every render
learning: Wrap a derived filter/map passed as props (e.g. Autocomplete options) in `useMemo`. A new array identity every render churns the consumer and re-runs its filtering.

title: Clipboard write neither awaited nor caught
learning: `navigator.clipboard.writeText` returns a promise that can reject (permissions, insecure context). Await it inside try/catch and set the 'copied' state only on success.

title: Large flat sx style object instead of a CSS module
learning: Long selector-heavy styling belongs in a CSS module, as elsewhere in the repo, not a flat TS `sx` object with stringly keyed selectors. If it must stay in TS, nest the selectors.

title: New pure helpers and hooks shipped without unit tests
learning: New pure utilities and hooks, especially ones several surfaces depend on, need their own unit tests covering their branch rules. Story-only coverage and a coverage drop on the touched files are review blockers.

title: Wrapping a throwing formatter in try/catch pushes fallback to the wrong layer
learning: Counter-learning: a formatter that throws on invalid input (e.g. date-fns `format` on NaN) is a useful signal that a boundary skipped validation. Validate at the parse boundary (return null for unparseable values) and keep the formatter strict. A catch inside the formatter forces one fallback on every caller and silently blanks output for callers whose input is valid.

title: Terminal-state shortcut in a shared gate re-enables actions
learning: Before changing what a shared boolean gate returns (e.g. an 'expired' check), audit every consumer it gates. A shortcut that is right for a warning banner can re-enable Confirm/Execute for items that must stay blocked; add a separate gate for the other meaning if needed.

title: Comment that cross-references another comment
learning: Drop comments that only point at other comments ('swallowed for the same reason as above'). They go stale and add no information the code does not carry.

title: Same version allowlist inlined at several call sites
learning: Lists that encode one rule, such as which Safe versions have an official handler or library, must share one constant so the next version is added in one place. Put it in a neutral shared module; generic hooks and utilities must not import it from a feature module.

title: Whole polled collection added to a simulation callback's deps
learning: When an effect or callback needs one value from a frequently refreshed collection, derive that value (e.g. a symbol string) with useMemo and depend on it, not the whole collection. Otherwise every poll re-runs expensive work such as a simulation.

title: safe-deployments bumped without the protocol-kit that resolves the same deployments
learning: When bumping `@safe-global/safe-deployments`, bump the SDK packages (protocol-kit / safe-core-sdk) that bundle their own copy in the same change, or track the follow-up. Otherwise the app and the SDK resolve different deployment sets for the same chain.

title: Signature-type branches left without tests
learning: A validator that branches on encoded variants (e.g. signature v-types: contract, pre-validated, eth_sign, ECDSA) needs a test per branch, not only the common one.

title: Cypress spec bypasses page objects and the shared localStorage helpers
learning: Cypress specs seed localStorage only through the established helpers (`main.addToLocalStorage` / `addToAppLocalStorage`) and keep selectors and interactions in page objects. New setup helpers and raw `cy.get` selectors in specs create competing, duplicated paths.

title: role="button" divs lost keyboard activation in a component-library migration
learning: Replacing library controls (e.g. MUI ListItemButton or Autocomplete) with plain elements must keep their keyboard contract: Enter/Space activation, and arrow/Enter selection for comboboxes. Prefer a real button primitive; a `role="button"` div with `tabIndex` but no key handler can be focused but not activated.

title: Hard-coded feature values in tests instead of randomized picks
learning: When a test exercises 'any feature/flag/chain', draw the value randomly from the valid set instead of hard-coding one or two. Hard-coded picks hide assumptions the code under test makes about specific values.

title: Ad-hoc env save/restore instead of the shared test helper
learning: Once a shared helper exists for toggling an env flag in tests, use it everywhere. Ad-hoc save/restore copies re-introduce leaks such as the 'undefined' string restore.

title: `as unknown as` cast to build a partial domain object in tests
learning: Build valid domain objects in tests (via a builder or full literal) instead of `({ ... }) as unknown as T`. The double cast hides missing required fields from the type checker.

title: Stale mock left after the code under test stops using a dependency
learning: When a change removes a dependency from the code under test, remove its mocks and spies from the tests too. Stale mocks suggest a contract that no longer exists and can mask future wiring.

title: Verbose code comments narrate backstory instead of the non-obvious why
learning: Code comments should be one or two lines stating the invariant or constraint a reader cannot get from the code. Line-by-line traces of library internals, ticket backstory and decision history belong in the PR description or a doc, not the source.

title: Form values diverged from the input or went stale when their dependency changed
learning: A controlled input mapped an unfinished entry to the same value as empty (null), so the form submitted; a token change called RHF `resetField`, which restored the stale seeded default instead of clearing the amount; a threshold field with no rule tied to the signer list kept a stale value that only failed as an on-chain revert. Keep the form value honest about what the input shows, clear dependent fields explicitly, and give them validation that re-runs when their inputs change.

title: Id-keyed watch ref never pruned, so a returning id is skipped
learning: A ref or map that mirrors which ids are being watched must drop ids that leave the source collection. Otherwise an 'already monitored' equality short-circuit skips re-watching when the same id and target come back.

title: Persisted slice leaks between describe blocks that don't clear localStorage
learning: When the store slice under test is persisted, every describe block that renders the store must clear localStorage in beforeEach, not only one of them. Otherwise rehydrated state from an earlier test makes the suite order-dependent.

title: Counter: assert the user-visible error copy instead of adding a data-testid
learning: When a test asserts a user-facing message, assert the visible text; that copy is the component's contract. Swapping it for a test ID makes the test stop catching a wrong-copy regression.

title: Critical fix bundled with unrelated UI changes and AI working files
learning: Keep one ticket per PR: a P1 fix bundled with unrelated UI changes can't be reviewed, verified or reverted on its own. Don't commit AI working docs or before/after screenshot assets; keep them in the PR description or gitignored.

title: Async init effect keeps a stale result on failure, and stable deps removed its accidental retry
learning: An async init effect must clear its stored result when the init fails and ignore results from superseded runs. When you stabilize its dependencies, check whether render churn was the only thing retrying a failed init, and replace that with an explicit bounded retry.

title: Feature-flag and availability checks duplicated at the mount site
learning: When the feature registry already stubs disabled lazy features to render null, mount the feature component bare; don't repeat the flag check at the call site. Fold availability states (e.g. UNAVAILABLE -> null) into the feature's own hook or component instead of checking them in each consumer.

title: Per-feature env var added to force-enable a feature flag
learning: Don't add per-feature env vars to override a backend feature flag locally. Use the shared local feature-flag override UI, and gate on the flag hook alone, so there is one override path per flag.

title: Counter: keep a flag check in the parent when it also drives parent layout
learning: Moving a feature-flag check into the child component is the default, but keep it in the parent when the same flag also controls the parent's own layout (a grid column or class the child cannot set on an ancestor).

title: New validation and guard branches landed without per-branch tests
learning: Each new validation branch (threshold bounds, reserved addresses) needs a test that fails if it is removed, and a two-part guard that accepts several variants needs a non-canonical variant plus a counterexample for each half, so a regression to canonical-only matching or a dropped condition fails.

title: Analytics param reused across features, typed inconsistently, fired for no-op actions
learning: Give each analytics concept its own event property instead of reusing another feature's param (e.g. RESULT for a member role), keep one value type per property across all events, and fire an event only when the action actually does something.

title: Narrowing CI env to step scope silently drops a secret a later step read
learning: When moving CI secrets from a job-wide export ($GITHUB_ENV, toJSON(secrets)) to step-scoped env blocks, list every later step in the same job that read the old job scope and give it its own env entry. A consistency test that checks the build step won't catch a sibling step that lost a variable.

title: Effect on a watched form value reopens UI after a programmatic reset
learning: Reactions meant for user edits (opening a suggestion list, focusing, showing hints) belong in the input's change handler. An effect keyed on the watched form value also fires on reset() and setValue, reopening UI the user just dismissed.

title: Constant derivations recomputed on every call from render paths
learning: Helpers called from render paths should not rebuild constant data (flattened address lists, decoded interface selectors) on every call; hoist it to module-level constants.

title: Deletion or rename leaves orphaned exports, assets and stale comment references
learning: After deleting a component or renaming a concept, sweep in the same change for exports, CSS classes and assets that now have no consumer, and for comments or JSDoc that still name the removed symbol.

title: Invariant enforced at one read site but not at the other sites that use the same state
learning: When a slice establishes an invariant such as 'unknown keys are ignored', derive it from one shared helper and apply it at every read and write site (selectors, apply/reset reducers, hooks), not only the one that exposed the bug.

title: Test fixture happens to equal the value a buggy implementation would produce
learning: Pick fixture values that can't coincide with a hardcoded or default result (a 1 ETH balance formats to exactly '1'), and assert whole messages rather than prefixes, so the test fails if the implementation hardcodes the output.

title: Verbose or misleading comments, including one naming a module that doesn't exist
learning: Keep a comment only when removing it would invite someone to 'fix' the code back into the bug; cut comments that restate the code, and never reference helpers or modules that don't exist. Test descriptions follow the same rule: one line, or none.

title: Global token redefined for one surface; px values mirroring a spacing utility
learning: Fix one component's look with component-scoped variables or classes rather than redefining a global theme token every other consumer shares, and derive insets and sizes from the spacing/theme variable the matching element uses (`--spacing(3)` for `px-3`) instead of hard-coding the pixel value it currently resolves to.

title: Layout bug fixes shipped without a Storybook state, so Argos cannot catch recurrence
learning: A visual or layout bug fix needs a Storybook story that renders the broken state (nesting, long content, error state, dismissed state) so the visual-regression run catches a recurrence. Class-string snapshots and DOM unit tests don't verify geometry, and components with no story have no visual coverage at all.

title: Story fixture hand-copies production config and keeps the old mapping
learning: Story and test fixtures that mirror production config (navigation items, icon mappings) should be derived from that config. A hand-copied fixture keeps the old UI in visual snapshots after the real config changes.

title: Icon mapping test only checks that some element was returned
learning: When the behavior under test is choosing the right icon or component, assert its identity (the element's type) for every changed mapping; isValidElement passes for any wrong icon.

title: Mixed save starts removals before the permission gate resolves, and a device wipe removes the new replacement
learning: In a save that both adds and removes, resolve the permission or registration gate first and return before any removal if it fails. Base destructive decisions (unregister the device) on the final desired selection, not on the pre-save state, so a replacement registered moments earlier isn't wiped.

title: Tests cast partial globals with as unknown as instead of building real objects
learning: Tests should construct real objects or use jest.spyOn on the real global instead of casting a partial literal with `as unknown as`; the double cast hides missing members and contract drift.

title: Component tests mock the hook, so nothing covers the component-to-hook wiring
learning: When a component's tests all mock the hook it calls, deleting that call keeps every test green. Let at least one component test run through the real hook against MSW, and don't add a browser E2E whose assertions only duplicate existing unit coverage.

title: E2E expected strings inlined in the spec instead of the page object
learning: Keep E2E expected copy and constants in the page object next to the locators that use them, as the test's own independent copy (not imported from app code), so a copy change still fails the test. New E2E specs go under the Playwright suite.

title: Shared components reused with divergent props, or reuse forced where inputs differ
learning: Use a shared component with the props its other instances of the same pattern use (every 'Learn more' link), since a one-off override like `noIcon` makes the UI inconsistent. The converse holds: two helpers with the same purpose aren't duplicates when reusing one would thread data (full owner arrays) through a type that only carries summaries.

title: Security widget states a confident 'no check' from a transient state that stops polling
learning: Don't render a confident absence claim (no check requested, nothing found) from a state that may be transient when polling stops at that state and the cache keeps it. Either keep polling until absence is confirmed or render nothing.

title: Dialog opened from another dialog renders without its backdrop
learning: A dialog opened from inside another dialog must pass the shared primitive's nested-backdrop option (forceBackdrop), because the UI library drops nested backdrops and the two dialogs visually merge.

title: Variable-length list inside a fixed-height overflow:hidden container gets clipped
learning: A list whose length depends on data must not sit in a fixed-height container with overflow hidden; let it scroll or grow. Clipped rows can't be seen or toggled but still submit their default state.

title: Validator swapped when async data loads, but React Hook Form keeps the stale error
learning: Re-registering a field with a new validate callback only merges options; React Hook Form does not re-run validation. When a field's rules depend on data that loads later (token decimals, balances), call trigger(field) when that data changes, or a value entered earlier keeps its cached error and blocks submit.

title: Hard-coded icon sizes and both theme images mounted
learning: Size a reserved gutter and the icon it holds from one shared custom property instead of repeating the pixel value, and pick one light/dark image `src` via the dark-mode hook rather than mounting both and hiding one with CSS, which still downloads both. Ship raster art as JPG/WebP, not base64 inside an SVG.

title: Personal tooling entry added to the shared .gitignore in a feature PR
learning: Don't add ignore entries or files for personal local tooling to shared repo config in a feature PR; keep them in your global gitignore or .git/info/exclude.

title: Failure telemetry uploads raw error messages and stacks
learning: Errors sent to RUM/Datadog must use the sanitized message (normalizeError's sanitizedMessage) and a sanitized or omitted stack. Raw provider and executor messages embed addresses, hashes and calldata, and the first stack line repeats the message, so a raw stack leaks the same identifiers.

title: Error classification by message text, one library's shape, or a bare catch
learning: Classify errors on typed evidence: user cancellations by error type, not message text (a wrapper can rethrow under another message), rate limits by every provider shape in the call path (ethers `SERVER_ERROR` 429 as well as viem `BaseError`), and a best-effort catch skips only the expected 'not ready' condition while rethrowing invariant guards. Count only failures of the attempted operation, not post-success cleanup.

title: Dark-mode override rule instead of a theme-aware token expression
learning: Derive mode-specific shades from theme tokens in one declaration (e.g. color-mix of a brand token with the contrast token) instead of adding a separate :global(.dark) override rule. One expression keeps position and transparency identical across modes and follows the tokens automatically.

title: Filtered list recomputed each render and memo placed after early returns
learning: Memoize filtered/derived lists with useMemo on their real inputs, and place the hook above every early return so hook order is identical between renders. A memo added at the point of use below conditional returns breaks the rules of hooks.

title: Focus assertion passed with the handler deleted
learning: toHaveTextContent on a container matches the whole subtree, so it can pass whatever element holds focus. Assert focus on the specific element (toHaveFocus or identity with document.activeElement), and prove each behavioural test by deleting the code it covers and watching it fail.

title: Unstyleable native control instead of an opt-in on the shared primitive
learning: Native browser affordances (the type="search" clear button) take the browser accent colour and cannot be themed. Add the behaviour to the shared primitive as an opt-in prop that reuses the design system's existing pattern (ghost icon button with the lucide X, as the Combobox clear does), so current consumers stay untouched.

title: Derived rows recreated each render reset the table's pagination
learning: When a child treats a new rows/items reference as a dataset change (resetting page, selection or scroll), memoize the derived array on its real inputs. Otherwise unrelated parent state, such as opening an edit modal, recreates the array and resets the child.

title: Table migration dropped row actions and E2E hooks
learning: When moving a surface onto a new shared component, diff it against the old rendering: every responsive variant keeps the per-row actions users had (copy, open in explorer), data-testid hooks that E2E page objects scope through stay in place, and E2E specs whose interaction semantics changed (sort click cycle) are updated in the same PR.

title: Post-mutation refetch chose queries by request timing
learning: To make sure queries racing a mutation end with fresh data, wait for running queries to settle and then invalidate the mutation's tags again, instead of choosing queries by request-id intersection (which misses queries started mid-mutation). Limit the refetch to cache entries providing those tags; a shared injected API's running-queries list includes unrelated endpoints.

title: Feature and barrel exports pulled flagged or heavy code into the host bundle
learning: A component behind its own feature flag loads through the feature handle and contract (`useLoadFeature`), not a direct barrel export, and a barrel that light hooks are imported from must not re-export a heavy provider (ethers, protocol-kit); import it from its own path at the single mount site so consumers don't start deep-importing to dodge it.

title: Story re-registers the global MSW loader
learning: Web stories must not add loaders: [mswLoader]; the loader is installed globally in the Storybook preview, and a local copy duplicates the shared MSW lifecycle.

title: Narrative multi-line comments and docstrings
learning: Keep code comments to one line stating a non-obvious why; remove multi-paragraph JSDoc that narrates appearance, control flow, pixel math or design intent the code already shows. Match sibling style: do not add a doc comment to one prop when the others have none.

title: New helper and hook branches shipped without unit tests
learning: Each new classifier, helper, or hook branch gets a focused unit test in the same PR, including the rejection/thrown path of async handlers and a case that pins derived configuration (e.g. a selector resolved through a registry) so a registry change breaks the test rather than the UI.

title: Module placed by motivating feature instead of by its consumers
learning: Place a module next to what consumes it, not next to the feature that motivated it. Infrastructure read by core hooks (safe info, chain id, SDK, read-only provider) stays in the shared location even when the first entry point is feature-specific.

title: Same status predicate re-derived in several consumers
learning: When several consumers derive the same boolean from a hook's return value (status === 'active', status === 'trialing'), return the named boolean from the hook so the rule lives in one place.

title: Single-row button layout overflows at narrow widths
learning: Before forcing actions into one row, check at 320px and with enlarged text: nowrap button labels with long copy overflow or overlap, and an absolutely positioned sibling (a Back button) does not share the row's layout, so the two can cover each other's click targets. Keep controls in one layout flow and give a narrow-width fallback.

title: Shared vs local write scope decided by route and address only
learning: Decide whether a write goes to a shared (workspace) store by the entity's actual membership at address plus chain granularity, not by the current route. A route shortcut and an address-only match both leak local data into the shared store.

title: try/catch around an RTK mutation trigger that never throws
learning: An RTK Query mutation trigger resolves with { data } or { error } unless .unwrap() is called, so a surrounding try/catch never sees API failures. Either inspect result.error or unwrap, not both.

title: Permission gate open while its data loads and missing on some entry points
learning: A permission derived from a still-loading query must default to withheld while the answer is unknown (only when there is something to check, so signed-out users are not blocked), not treat undefined data as 'not a member'. Apply the gate at every surface that offers the action, not just the main menus.

title: Shared CI or shared-contract fixes folded into a feature PR
learning: When a feature PR hits a failure in shared CI config or a shared contract (a store API with other callers), open a separate PR or ticket for it instead of widening the feature PR. Fixing it inline changes behaviour for every other caller under an unrelated review.

title: Narrative JSDoc and comments describing removed behaviour
learning: Comments are one line of non-obvious rationale: multi-paragraph JSDoc restating control flow, layout arithmetic, or process notes (coverage, verification history) belongs in the PR description, and a comment describing a path the change removed is updated or deleted in the same change.

title: Shared function's return type narrowed to fit a new branch
learning: When a new branch of a shared function would return a different response shape, do not collapse the return type to the lowest common denominator (e.g. just an id), which throws away data existing callers relied on. Route the new behaviour through the paths that need it and remove parameters no caller passes.

title: Responsive layout not checked at narrow widths
learning: New or restyled layouts must be checked at mobile widths (about 360px) before review. When a row variant adopts a shared responsive grid class, every gridArea the row uses must exist in each breakpoint template; give the variant its own template rather than editing the shared one, and verify with stories at several widths since unit tests do not exercise layout.

title: Chain logs cached permanently while still within reorg range
learning: Do not permanently cache data read near the chain head (event logs, receipts): a reorg can replace it, and the cache then serves stale arguments for the whole session. Cache only entries at least a reorg-depth margin behind the head (about 12 blocks) and re-read recent ones.

title: Half of a behaviour fix left without its own regression test
learning: Every branch a fix adds needs a test that fails when that branch is reverted, including each path of a conditional (e.g. both the finished and unfinished state of a trigger) and each app that got the change. Confirm by mutating the source and watching the test fail.

title: Dead tab stops and focus dropped to body
learning: Keep keyboard focus order intact. An element that is not actionable yet should not be a tab stop: render the trigger only when it can act (an always-present disabled trigger or a tabindex div without a role stays focusable). When a focused element is about to be hidden (visibility:hidden, display:none), move focus to its replacement first, because Chrome drops focus to body and the next Tab restarts from the top.

title: Expected outcomes logged as errors; real failures silenced as cancellations
learning: Match error handling to the real outcome in both directions: rule out an expected case before calling a helper that logs on failure (a test that stubs `console.error` to stay quiet is the signal), and when suppressing feedback for a user cancel, match only the explicit cancellation so provider failures such as `server_error` keep a user-facing error.

title: Story re-registers the global MSW loader
learning: Web stories must not add loaders: [mswLoader]; it is installed globally in the Storybook preview. Many existing stories still carry it, so copying a neighbour does not make it right.

title: E2E spec waits fixed wall time to outlast app timers
learning: E2E specs must not sleep a fixed duration to outlast application debounces or validation timers; elapsed time proves nothing under loaded CI. Move timing-dependent assertions to a unit/component test with fake timers and keep the E2E spec on observable sequences. Playwright's clock does not fake the MessageChannel React's scheduler uses, so it cannot make such React timing deterministic.

title: Debounced error shows a stale message
learning: A debounced display value lags its source, so gating it only on 'is there a current error' shows the previous message when an input is fixed and broken again within the delay. Show the debounced value only when it is the current value (same error object), or reset it synchronously when the source clears.

title: Stale probe response tears down a renewed session
learning: Before acting destructively on an async probe's result (expiring a session, wiping state), check that the state that started the probe is unchanged, e.g. by capturing the session expiry or id before the request. A late 403 for an old session must not expire a session renewed meanwhile, possibly from another tab.

title: Deep import of a pure feature helper from a boot path
learning: Importing a pure helper by its deep path is acceptable when the feature barrel eagerly re-exports hooks and components that would drag into a boot-time module graph (the store), provided the import boundary lint allows it and the pattern is established. The public-API rule protects lazy loading; going through that barrel here would defeat it.

title: Unknown amount coalesced to zero and displayed
learning: Do not coalesce an 'unknown' numeric (null from an empty or unparseable input) to 0 for display; `?? 0` turns absence into a real figure such as $0.00. Render nothing until a value exists.

title: Step-local state lost on Back and hidden by an unfaithful test double
learning: UI state that must survive step navigation in a multi-step flow lives above the step container, not inside a step that unmounts. Test doubles of such containers must mount one step at a time like the real one; a double that renders every step at once hides remount bugs.

title: Pre-existing bug fix deferred out of a move-only change
learning: When code is only moved, fix a pre-existing bug found in it in a separate change if the fix would alter another flow's behaviour; likewise, changing a contract shared by every flow gets its own change. Record it as a ticket instead of riding along.

title: Lookup cache key omits the network it resolved against
learning: A cache key must include every dimension that changes the answer. Name lookups served by different registries (mainnet vs testnet hub) need the source chain in the key, not only the address or coin type, or one network's answer is served for the other.

title: Lazy-loading a module the initial bundle already contains
learning: Before adding a dynamic import() to keep a module out of the initial bundle, check whether it is already statically reachable from the entry graph (and read the bundle report). Lazy-loading an already-loaded module adds async loading states to every consumer for no size win.

title: Inline test-data factories duplicated across test files
learning: Test data built by ad-hoc inline factories that repeat across files should become a shared builder, reused by every test that needs the shape.

title: Near-copies of sibling constants and error components
learning: Before adding a constant or a state component (error/retry, empty), search sibling features: hoist a constant used by two siblings into their parent constants file and reuse the existing error component instead of a near-identical copy.

title: Reset-on-identity-change fires on a transient unknown identity
learning: An effect that clears a selection when the target entity changes must ignore transitions into an unknown state ('' or undefined during navigation or loading) and only compare known identities; otherwise A to unknown to A wipes the user's choice. Test both A-unknown-A (keep) and A-unknown-B (clear on reaching B).
